title: Spatial Phase Control of Energy and Ergotropy in Quantum Batteries
summary: We investigate the role of spatial geometry in controlling energy storage and work extraction in a non-Markovian quantum battery. The system consists of two identical two-level systems coupled to a structured waveguide reservoir, where one qubit serves as the charger and the other as the battery. The spatial separation between the qubits introduces a geometry-dependent phase that governs collective interference, directly modulating the decay channels and energy transfer dynamics.
